goal: Make pmp-current-map-v12.json the sole source of application destination truth while preserving the visible app, Bank data, user content, current screen restoration, and recovery evidence.
non_goals: No source-byte hash enforcement; that remains A-003.
No storage, IndexedDB, user-content, or cache clearing.
No feature redesign or visual redesign.
No merge to main during preparation.

authority_contract.bootstrap_rule: The canonical map path and resolver mechanism may be fixed. They may not contain alternate app destinations. Every application, tool, recovery, fallback, and historic-forward destination must come from the map.
resolver_behavior: Validate type, route-contract version, required roles, local relative HTML/JS/JSON paths, and allowed hash.
Issue an immutable in-memory route handoff containing map path, map version, route epoch, role, destination, cache key, and allowed hash.
Never consult v11, v10, v9, unversioned maps, localStorage route pointers, saved spots, move ledger, filenames, or hard-coded fallback destinations.
Fail closed to a copyable diagnostic when the map or required role is missing or invalid.
Do not clear or rewrite user data.

preconditions.condition: The 13-entry A-001 supplemental identity receipt passes with zero unresolved identities.
main still resolves to baseline commit 5dd049de1500ea427fa2cf395687239a19706115 or a new baseline identity freeze is performed.
Every proposed mutation has a preimage blob SHA and rollback action in audit/a002-rollback-ledger.json.

execution_phases.name: Identity reconciliation and baseline lock
actions: Verify all 13 exact identities at the pinned baseline.
Link the supplement to A-001 PASS-003 without modifying the A-001 branch.
Record combined source-identity coverage with zero unresolved.
execution_phases.gate: P0 must pass before any runtime source file is edited.

execution_phases.name: Create canonical map contract and strict resolver
actions: Add the shared resolver as a mechanism-only file with no alternate destination constants.
Expand Current Map v12 to name the full current runtime chain, tools, recovery routes, and historic policy.
Change the stable app entry so it loads the guardian path obtained from Current Map v12.
Change Route Guardian v22 so it reads Current Map v12 only, removes v11/v10 and hard-coded v29 fallbacks, and fails closed when the map is invalid.
gate_tests: Map v12 available: stable entry opens the map-declared guardian.
Map v12 missing or invalid: no old map, guardian, Reload Owner, or app target opens.
No destination string other than the map and resolver bootstrap exists in the entry or guardian.
No Bank, storage, IndexedDB, user-content, or cache clearing occurs.

execution_phases.name: Convert current boot and wrapper chain to map-issued handoffs
actions: Reload Owner obtains current_app and the first runtime_chain destination from the resolver instead of hard-coding inner v30.
The live-update marker becomes revision/cache-bust data only; any marker target must be removed or required to match the map but may not select a path.
Each wrapper requests the next runtime_chain role from the same map-issued handoff instead of embedding the next filename.
Inner v3 obtains Home, Bug Memory, Resident, and Route Guardian Action destinations from map tool/base roles.
Home v6 obtains its historical payload URL from the map contract while leaving byte-hash enforcement to A-003.
gate_tests: The complete visible app reaches Home through the same current chain and preserves the requested hash.
Removing or corrupting any runtime_chain role fails closed at that role without consulting a historical route.
The marker revision can refresh bytes but cannot change the destination.
Current screen, user content, Bank state, IndexedDB, and localStorage data remain intact.
No runtime hash-certification claim is made.

execution_phases.name: Converge every active Reload Current path
actions: Remove all v9, v27, v20, v21, v11, and v10 route selection.
Preserve current-screen snapshot capture and restoration.
Make every Reload Current control call one canonical resolver-backed reload API.
Route through the map-declared guardian/current app only.
gate_tests: Reload Current from World, Bridge, Library, Workshop, Control, and Bank returns to the same screen through Current Map v12.
No active reload trace fetches v11, v10, v9, unversioned map, or directly names an old guardian/owner.
Rapid repeated clicks remain guarded and do not duplicate navigation.
No saved content or Bank data changes.

execution_phases.name: Convert tool returns and manual route actions
actions: Read Safe Writer, Code Safety, Bug Memory, Resident, route-action, and return destinations from map tool_routes.
Remove stale return=current-v27 and missing pmp-clean-v13.html contracts.
Return to the map-declared current app while preserving the requested screen hash.
Keep in-shell Safe Writer behavior where already used; path ownership still comes from the map.
gate_tests: Open and return from Safe Writer without visiting v27.
Open and return from Code Safety without requesting pmp-clean-v13.html.
Route Guardian actions return through the canonical map path.
Tool workspaces and staged content remain unchanged.

execution_phases.name: Remove independent authority from Last Good and recovery
actions: Preserve saved spots and move-ledger evidence but remove their ability to execute arbitrary local HTML directly.
Treat saved paths as candidates requiring an explicit Current Map recovery allowlist entry.
Make Last Good and Recovery Tools destinations map-defined.
Convert historic current-before hard-codes into map roles or evidence-only values.
Make Route Guardian v14 and old inner recovery wrappers delegate to the canonical map or display inactive evidence.
gate_tests: Saved spots and move ledger remain readable and unchanged.
A saved arbitrary path cannot execute unless allowed by Current Map recovery policy.
Last Good returns to the map-declared current app.
Recovery failure never promotes v9, v13, v14, v16, or another historical target as current authority.

execution_phases.name: Neutralize historic maps, guardians, owners, and wrappers
actions: Remove current status claims from old map data and mark it historic evidence only.
Convert directly opened old guardians and Reload Owners into map-delegating forwarders or fail-closed historic notices.
Ensure old wrappers cannot independently launch an application chain.
Retain files and evidence; do not delete history.
gate_tests: Directly opening each historic guardian/owner/wrapper cannot launch an old current route.
No production actor fetches an old map.
Historic files remain inspectable as evidence.
Current Map v12 remains the only object containing current destination truth.

execution_phases.name: Transport, saturation, and certification audit
actions: Verify network-first service-worker behavior does not promote stale route files.
Repeat the 65-object authority census against patched sources.
Require every former authority to be canonical-map data, map executor, map delegate, influence-only, evidence-only, inactive, disabled, or proven absent.
Issue A-002 pass receipt only when zero independent route authorities remain.
gate_tests: Zero independent current, fallback, reload, tool-return, recovery, saved-route, candidate, or historic route selectors remain.
Current Map unavailable causes fail-closed behavior everywhere.
All six screen hashes survive normal and Reload Current flows.
No user data, Bank data, IndexedDB, or staged tool content is lost.
A-003 hash enforcement is not claimed.

execution_rules: Execute one phase at a time in order.
Commit each phase separately so it can be reverted independently.
Run the phase gate before beginning the next phase.
On any gate failure, stop immediately and invoke the matching rollback group.
Do not merge the draft PR while any phase is untested, unresolved, or rolled back incompletely.
Do not clear caches or storage to make a test pass; stale-state behavior must be observed and handled safely.
